title: 박규남 박사, Eindhoven University of Technology(TU/e) 조교수 부임
paras: AIM랩 석사 졸업생 Gyunam Park 박사(지도교수 Minseok Song)께서 지난 2025년 7월부로 Eindhoven University of Technology(TU/e)의 Process Analytics Cluster in the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science에 Assistant Professor(조교수)로 부임하였습니다. 박규남 박사님께서는 UNIST 컴퓨터공학과 학사, POSTECH 산업경영공학과 석사 과정을 거쳐 POSTECH Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center의 명예 센터장이자 독일 아헨공대 교수인 Prof. Wil van der Aalst 연구실에서 박사 학위를 취득하셨습니다. 또한, Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Information Technology에서 그룹 리더를 역임하며 연구와 산학 협력에서 탁월한 성과를 거두셨습니다. 앞으로도 박규남 교수님은 프로세스 마이닝(Process Mining) 및 데이터 사이언스(Data Science) 분야에서 활발한 연구 활동을 이어가며, 글로벌 학계와 산업 발전에 크게 기여할 것으로 기대됩니다.
👉 박규남 교수님에 대한 더 자세한 정보는 🔗https://www.gyunam.com 에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.
title_en: Dr. Gyunam Park Appointed Assistant Professor at Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e)
paras_en: Dr. Gyunam Park, an AIM Lab master's program alumnus (advisor: Prof. Minseok Song), was appointed Assistant Professor in the Process Analytics Cluster of the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science at Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) as of July 2025. Dr. Park received his bachelor's degree from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at UNIST and his master's degree from the Department of Industrial and Management Engineering at POSTECH, and earned his Ph.D. in the research group of Prof. Wil van der Aalst, Honorary Director of the POSTECH Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center and Professor at RWTH Aachen University in Germany. He also served as a group leader at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Information Technology, where he achieved outstanding results in both research and industry-academia collaboration. Prof. Park is expected to continue his active research in process mining and data science and to contribute greatly to the global academic community and to industry.
More information about Prof. Gyunam Park is available at https://www.gyunam.com.

title: Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center 개소식 및 AP-PM 워크숍 진행
paras: 2024년 9월 24일에 Wil van der Aalst 교수님께서 포스코 체인지업 그라운드에 방문하셔서 Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center 개소식 기념 keynote 강연을 진행하셨습니다. Wil van der Aalst 교수님께서는 Process Mining 분야의 창시자이시며, Object-Centric Process Mining에 대한 keynote 강연을 진행해주셨습니다.
개소식 이후에는 9월 24일에 이어 25일까지 Asia-Pacific Process Mining 워크샵을 진행하였습니다. 워크샵에는 포항공대 산경과 구성원과 Celonis Korea, 삼성화재, 한림대병원, LG전자, 그리고 UNIST, 광운대, 경희대, 부산대 교수님들께서 참석해주셨습니다.
또한 9월 25일 오후에는 Wil van der Aalst 교수님께서 Aim 랩 구성원들과 연구 세미나를 진행하였습니다.
title_en: Opening Ceremony of the Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center and AP-PM Workshop
paras_en: On September 24, 2024, Prof. Wil van der Aalst visited POSCO Changeup Ground and delivered a keynote lecture to commemorate the opening of the Wil van der Aalst Data & Process Science Research Center. Prof. Wil van der Aalst is the founder of the field of process mining, and his keynote lecture addressed Object-Centric Process Mining.

Following the opening ceremony, the Asia-Pacific Process Mining Workshop was held from September 24 through September 25. The workshop was attended by members of the Department of Industrial and Management Engineering at POSTECH, along with participants from Celonis Korea, Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance, Hallym University Medical Center, and LG Electronics, as well as professors from UNIST, Kwangwoon University, Kyung Hee University, and Pusan National University.
In addition, on the afternoon of September 25, Prof. Wil van der Aalst held a research seminar with the members of the AIM Lab.

paras: 포스텍 명예 교수 서의호 교수님께서 대학지도자회의에서 기조 연설을 하였습니다.

대구경북과기원(DGIST) 총장 전략특보인 서의호 박사(포스텍 명예교수)가 최근 러시아 국립 민족연구기술대학교(MISIS, Национальный исследовательский технологический университет, НИТУ «МИСиС»)에서 열린 대학지도자회의(2018 리서치 엑셀런스 서밋)에서 기조연설을 했다. 서 박사는 서밋 연설에서 “한국 연구대학의 역사는 비록 짧지만 눈부신 성장을 이룩했다"며 "KAIST, POSTECH, DGIST, GIST, UNIST 등의 5개 과기대와 서울대 등 주요 종합대학의 연구가 한국 기술의 경쟁력 향상에 크게 기여했다”고 강조했다.
서밋 회의장에는 미하일 코스티코프 러시아 과학교육부 장관, 알레티나 체르니코바 MISIS 총장, 알래인 퓨시 프랑스 파리 과학인문학대학교 총장 등 러시아 정부 관계자와 세계 유수의 대학 총장및 교수들이 참석했다.
title_en: Keynote Speech at the University Leaders' Conference
paras_en: POSTECH Emeritus Professor Euiho Suh delivered a keynote speech at the University Leaders' Conference.

Dr. Euiho Suh (POSTECH Emeritus Professor), Special Advisor for Strategy to the President of DGIST, recently delivered a keynote speech at the University Leaders' Conference (2018 Research Excellence Summit) held at the National University of Science and Technology MISIS (Национальный исследовательский технологический университет, НИТУ «МИСиС») in Russia. In his address at the summit, Dr. Suh emphasized, "Although the history of research universities in Korea is short, they have achieved remarkable growth," adding that "research at the five science and technology universities, including KAIST, POSTECH, DGIST, GIST, and UNIST, and at major comprehensive universities such as Seoul National University has greatly contributed to strengthening the competitiveness of Korean technology."

The summit was attended by Russian government officials as well as presidents and professors of leading universities worldwide, including Mikhail Kotyukov, Russian Minister of Science and Higher Education, Alevtina Chernikova, Rector of MISIS, and Alain Fuchs, President of Paris Sciences et Lettres University (PSL) in France.

title: 인공지능(AI) 패션 코디네이터
paras: AIM Lab에서 진행한 AI 기반 패션 큐레이터 시스템 구축 연구의 보도자료입니다.

포스텍(포항공대)은 송민석 산업경영공학과 교수 연구팀이 삼성물산과 공동 연구로 AI 패션 큐레이션 서비스를 개발해, 삼성물산 패션부문 통합 온라인몰 SSF샵(www.ssfshop.com)에 서비스하고 있다고 8일 밝혔다. 개발된 AI는 패션 전문가가 만든 스타일링을 학습해, 온라인 쇼핑몰을 찾은 고객이 고른 옷과 가장 잘 어울리는 옷을 추천해 준다. 기존 패션 AI는 고객이 함께 구매한 옷을 통계적으로 처리해 보여주거나 유사한 옷을 찾아주는 데 그쳤다. 하지만 포스텍이 개발한 AI는 고객이 상의를 고르면 하의ㆍ외투ㆍ신발ㆍ가방 등을 어울리는 스타일로 ‘머리부터 발끝까지’ 추천해준다. (중략) 송민석 교수는 “현재는 인공지능을 기반으로 어울리는 패션 아이템을 추천해주는 정도이지만, 향후 추가 연구를 통해 소비자가 자신의 전신사진을 온라인 쇼핑몰에 올리면 키와 체형, 피부색 등가 어울리는 옷을 연출해주는 쪽으로 시스템을 발전시켜 나갈 계획”이라고 말했다. (후략)

title_en: AI Fashion Coordinator
paras_en: This is a press release on the AI-based fashion curator system developed by the AIM Lab.

POSTECH announced on the 8th that a research team led by Prof. Minseok Song of the Department of Industrial and Management Engineering has developed an AI fashion curation service in joint research with Samsung C&T, and that the service is now offered on SSF Shop (www.ssfshop.com), the integrated online mall of Samsung C&T's fashion division. The AI learns from styling created by fashion experts and recommends the items that best match the clothing a customer selects in the online shopping mall. Existing fashion AI systems went no further than statistically processing items customers bought together or finding similar items. The AI developed by POSTECH, however, recommends a complete look "from head to toe" - bottoms, outerwear, shoes, bags, and more - once the customer selects a top. (Excerpt omitted) Prof. Minseok Song said, "At present the system recommends matching fashion items using artificial intelligence, but through further research we plan to develop it so that a consumer can upload a full-body photo to an online shopping mall and receive outfits styled to suit their height, body type, skin tone, and so on." title: 빅데이터 홍수 시대, 프로세스 마이닝으로 혁신하다
paras: 송민석 포스텍 산업경영공학과 교수가 이끄는 분석 및 정보관리 연구실은 삼성전자, 포스코, 삼성물산, 서울대병원, 한국축구협회 등 다양한 곳과 협력해 데이터 기반 혁신을 구현하고 있다. 데이터는 많지만 이를 활용하는 데 어려움을 겪는 산업계에 문제를 정의해주고 문제를 푸는 다양한 방법을 활용해 해결해준다. 문제해결에 필요한 방법이 없다면 새로운 방법론을 만들어주는 연구도 수행한다. 연구실의 주 연구분야는 데이터와 프로세스를 연결하는 프로세스 마이닝이다. 데이터를 이용해 프로세스의 개선을 집중한다. 예를 들어 포스코에선 철강 생산을 위해 수많은 과정이 필요하다. 수많은 프로세스 중 특정 과정에서 잠깐만 부하가 걸려도 막대한 손실을 겪는다. 이를 분석해 부하를 예측하고 낮추면 생산 프로세스의 혁신을 가져올 수 있다. (후략)

title_en: Driving Innovation with Process Mining in the Age of Big Data
paras_en: The Analytics and Information Management Lab, led by Prof. Minseok Song of the Department of Industrial and Management Engineering at POSTECH, is realizing data-driven innovation in collaboration with a wide range of partners including Samsung Electronics, POSCO, Samsung C&T, Seoul National University Hospital, and the Korea Football Association. For industries that have abundant data but struggle to make use of it, the lab defines the problem and solves it using a variety of methods. When no existing method fits the problem, the lab also conducts research to develop new methodologies. The lab's main research area is process mining, which connects data and processes, with a focus on using data to improve processes. At POSCO, for example, steel production requires a great many steps, and even a brief bottleneck at one point among these numerous processes causes enormous losses. Analyzing this to predict and reduce the load can bring innovation to the production process. (abridged)

이번 Deep Learning 세미나는 Deep Learning에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 Python을 이용해 직접 실습해봄으로써 Deep Learning과 Python에 대한 이해의 깊이를 더하고자 합니다.

교재로는 DEEP LEARNING with Python(Chollet.)을 사용합니다.
title_en: Deep Learning with Python Seminar
paras_en: Following the Deep Learning seminar held in the spring semester of 2018, a seminar on implementing deep learning directly with Python will be held in the summer of 2018.
Building on an understanding of deep learning, this seminar aims to deepen the participants' understanding of both deep learning and Python through hands-on practice with Python.

All members of the AIM Lab take part in the seminar, which runs for one month starting July 2, 2018. Participants study together and share their views by researching, organizing, and presenting textbook material and literature.
The textbook used is DEEP LEARNING with Python (Chollet).

title: Moritz von Hoffen, Carlos Müller 본교 방문
paras: RISE BPM 공동연구를 위하여, Westfälische Wilhelms-Universität Münster(WWU)에서 Moritz von Hoffen, Universidad de Sevilla (USE)에서 Carlos Müller가 본교에 방문하였습니다.
Goal of Stay:
Moritz von Hoffen: During my secondment at POSTECH university, I would like to pursue two different research endeavors.

The first idea is to work on the application of sentiment analysis methods in the domain of the Sharing Economy. This research is closely related to WP1. In this context, I would like to conduct sentiment analysis on two different kinds of data provided from users of the Airbnb service. At first, tweets mentioning the hashtag #airbnb were collected over a duration of a couple of prior to my secondment. These tweets will be analyzed using techniques of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and sentiment analysis to derive insights regarding factors affecting service delivery in the Sharing Economy. Complementary to the analysis of tweets, reviews provided on the Airbnb website will also be analyzed. This serves the cause to investigate, whether the sentiments contained in tweets are in line with the ones mentioned in reviews.

The second idea that I would like to work on is the analysis of charging transaction data of electric vehicle’s charging transaction. Due to the real-time analytics and the involved smart charging stations, the WP2 and WP3 and possibly WP4 will benefit from this research. The enrichment of charging transaction data with contextual information, e.g. weather and POIs nearby, can be used to learn about charging behavior. In previous communication, the option of retrieving charging transaction data of the Korean-based PMGROW was discussed. Such a data set would allow for application of the different approaches for analytics and should yield interesting results.
Carlos Müller: The present stay is part of the WP3: Real-Time Computing involved in the first phase of the RISE BPM Project. Specifically, the objectives of this WP are:
To analyze real-time computing concepts and technology for the low latency monitoring and control of business process.
Analysis of the influence of real-time computing on the four areas of BPM.
Investigation of the mechanisms enabling organizations to respond to changes in their processes efficiently and effectively.

Since our research group have been working hard in the recent months on an interesting SLA & BPM-based monitoring platform for the Andalusian regional government health care system, the main goal of the secondment is to combine such a platform with the techniques applied by Minseok group to the Korean health care system or to the samsung company.

Goal of the stay:

Sebastiaan Zelst, van: Resource Network analysis in data intensive environments. Given the omnipresence of data, and, the high velocity at which data is produced within business processes, interesting questions arise such as: what resources are currently active? what resource is causing problems? What clusters of resources can we identify? etc. During the research visit we focus on discovering, visualizing analyzing such information, using a process mining focus. We investigate the intersection of existing (process mining based) social network analysis techniques, and, techniques aiming at handling huge amounts of (streaming) data.

Maikel Eck, van: The aim of process mining is to provide fact-based insights into the execution of processes. An important aspect of this is the discovery of process models based on behaviour captured in event data. During this research visit we investigate the discovery of state-based process models in on-line settings with changing processes.

paras: RISE BPM 공동연구를 위하여. Friedrich Chasin이 본교에 방문하였습니다.

Goal of the stay: The goal of the secondment is to analyze the processes and the structure of the businesses within the Sharing Economy that are part of the Sharing City Seoul Initiative. Sharing City Seoul is a governmental project that created partnerships with NGOs and private companies to make sharing an integral part of Seoul's economy. A particular goal is to understanding how smart devices are utilized by these sharing businesses in order to facilitate the sharing between individuals. Currently, several barriers exist, which limit the possible scenarios for exercising peer-to-peer sharing of various resources between individuals. An effective use of 'intelligent' devices is a potential solution for the emerged challenges and have high implications for the BPM within the domain of Sharing Economy of tomorrow. By analyzing the state of the art of the processes in the Sharing Economy businesses, it is our goal to be able to add knowledge to the body of research and provide implications for the emerging businesses in the practice. The aim of the project is therefore directly aligned with the goals defined in the WP2. Furthermore, given the nature of the Sharing Economy phenomenon, the project adds knowledge in regard to the societal impact factors in BPM to the outcome of the WP5.

paras: “삼성전기 1side Edge 논문대상”에서 석사 손숙영 학생과 동상을 수상하였습니다. 석사 손숙영 학생과 Benardo 박사는 “Process Mining for Manufacturing Process Analysis”라는 제목의 논문에서 프로세스 마이닝 기법을 이용한 제조공정 프로세스 분석 방법론을 제시하고, 삼성전기 데이터를 활용한 사례 연구를 통하여 논문에서 제안한 프레임워크의 활용성을 검증하였습니다. 1side Edge 논문대상은 삼성전기에서 주최하며, 핵심 전략 기술 및 미래 지향적인 제품을 중심으로 우수 기술인력을 발굴하고 산학협동의 토대를 구축하는 한편 역량 있는 인재들의 연구활동을 후원함으로써 글로벌 환경 속에서 세계 최고의 경쟁력과 기술력을 확보할 수 있는 기반을 조성하고자 제정되어 올해로 9회 차에 접어들었습니다. 특히 해당 논문대상에서는 박사과정 학생들의 수상이 대부분이나, 석사과정 중에 해당 성과를 거둔 것에 더욱 의미가 크다고 하겠습니다. 수상을 진심으로 축하드립니다.
title_en: Master's Student Sukyoung Son
paras_en: Master's student Sukyoung Son received the Bronze Prize at the "Samsung Electro-Mechanics 1side Edge Paper Award." In a paper titled "Process Mining for Manufacturing Process Analysis," master's student Sukyoung Son and Dr. Benardo proposed a methodology for analyzing manufacturing processes using process mining techniques and validated the applicability of the proposed framework through a case study using Samsung Electro-Mechanics data. The 1side Edge Paper Award, hosted by Samsung Electro-Mechanics, was established to identify outstanding technical talent in core strategic technologies and future-oriented products, to build a foundation for industry-academia cooperation, and to support the research activities of capable individuals, thereby creating a basis for securing world-class competitiveness and technological capability in a global environment; this year marks its ninth edition. title: 09학번 졸업생 손숙영 인터뷰
paras: UNIST 09학번 손숙영 인터뷰
“세상에 나와서 가장 좋았던 것은, 내 연구의 결과를 산업에 바로 접목하고 이를 확인할 수 있는 것이었어요. 연구의 방향성도 제대로 확인 할 수 있고요.”
지난 10월 27일 저녁, 울산시 남구 삼산동의 한 식당에서 마주 한 손숙영(25․경영학과 09학번)씨. 현대중공업 중앙기술원 선도기술연구소 공정IT연구실에 입사한 지 3개월이 채 되지 않은 UNIST 졸업생이다. 학사와 석사 통합과정을 밟아 5년 만에 졸업했고, 총학생회와 학부 학생회 활동도 부지런히 해냈다.
손 씨가 학교에서 주로 했던 연구 분야는 최근 중요성이 강조되고 있는 빅데이터(Big Data) 분석이었다. 그 중에서도 프로세스 마이닝(Process Mining)이다. 이 연구 분야는 다양한 행동이 기록된 데이터를 분석해 일정한 모델을 자동으로 도출하는 것이다.
손 씨가 현대중공업과 인연을 맺은 것은 작년 가을, 삼성전기에서 주최한 ‘제9회 Inside edge 논문대상’에서 동상을 받으면서다. 당시 손 씨의 논문을 유심히 살펴보던 현대중공업 관계자는 손 씨에게 입사지원을 권유했다.
“고민을 많이 했어요. 학업과 취업의 갈림길에서 선택을 해야 했으니까요. 며칠을 고민하던 차에 연구 결과를 현장에서 바로 적용해 볼 수 있는 취업을 선택했어요. 입사 지원서에 마침표를 찍으면서 새로운 길을 가게 된다는 생각에 가슴이 벅차오르기도 했죠.”
손 씨는 현대중공업 뿐 아니라 다른 유명 대기업에도 입사 지원서를 제출했다. 결과는 모두 합격, 이러저런 고민 끝에 현대중공업을 선택했다.
“지역적인 이유가 가장 컸죠. 더 큰 도시의 기업이라도 울산과 비슷하면 울산이 좋겠다는 생각이었죠. 모교가 인근에 있다는 것도 선택하는데 큰 역할을 했어요.”
손 씨에게 입사지원을 권유한 현대중공업 관계자는 현재 손 씨가 근무 중인 공정IT연구실에서 실장을 맡고 있다. UNIST 졸업생 가운데 현대중공업에서 일하는 직원은 모두 6명이다. 이 중 4명이 손 씨가 근무하는 공정IT연구실에서 활동 중이다. 전체 인원이 12명인 공정IT연구실의 33%가 UNIST출신으로 채워져 있다.
손 씨는 작년 10월 UNIST에 발전기금 100만원을 쾌척했다. 학생 기부 중 최고 금액이다. 발전기금을 낼 수 있었던 것도 앞서 언급된 논문대회 때문이었다.
“논문 대회에서 받은 상금을 어디에 사용하는 것이 좋을까 생각하다 학교 발전기금으로 기부하는 것이 좋을 것 같았어요. 송민석 교수님을 비롯해 연구실 선후배 등과 의논해 결정하게 됐어요.”
손 씨는 학교에 부채감을 갖고 있었다. 첫 입학생이라는 이유로 누렸던 많은 혜택, 당연히 누려야 하는 권리가 아니라 국가와 지역사회가 기회를 준 것이라고 했다. 그것을 되돌려 줘야 한다는 생각이 가득했다.
“사실 발전기금을 낸 것은 받은 사랑을 되돌려 준다는 의미가 컸어요. 앞으로 후배들의 안정된 학업과 연구를 위해 작은 힘이지만 보태고 싶어요. 가능하다면 UNIST 동문 활동도 열심히 하고 싶고요.”
손 씨는 UNIST에서 내일의 과학자 꿈을 기르고 있을 후배들에게도 한마디 했다. 손 씨의 남동생인 손재영(23․기계 및 신소재공학부)군 역시 UNIST에 재학 중이다. 그래서인지 손 씨는 후배들이 친동생 같고, 사랑스럽다고 강조했다.
“후배들이 보다 많은 세상을 봤으면 좋겠어요. 반연리가 세상의 전부가 아니라는 것을 명심하고, 여행도 다니고 다른 학교 학생들과 교류도 많이 하면서 견문을 넓혔으면 하는 바람이에요. 보이지 않던 것이 보이면, 해야 할 일이 많아지거든요.”
출처 : [UNIST 09학번 손숙영 인터뷰] “첫 입학생으로 받은 과분한 사랑 보답해 나갈 것” , 2014년11월 24일.
title_en: Interview with Sukyoung Son, Class of 2009 Graduate
paras_en: Interview with Sukyoung Son, UNIST Class of 2009

"The best part of entering the working world was being able to apply the results of my research directly to industry and see the outcome for myself. It also lets me properly verify the direction of my research."

On the evening of October 27, we met Sukyoung Son (25, Class of 2009, School of Business Administration) at a restaurant in Samsan-dong, Nam-gu, Ulsan. A UNIST graduate, she had been working for less than three months at the Process IT Research Lab of the Advanced Technology Research Institute, Hyundai Heavy Industries Central Research Institute. She completed the combined bachelor's and master's program, graduating in five years, and was also actively involved in the student union and the undergraduate student council.

The main research field Son worked on at school was big data analytics, an area of growing importance, and within it, process mining. This field involves analyzing data in which various activities are recorded in order to automatically derive a consistent model.

Son's connection with Hyundai Heavy Industries began last fall, when she won a bronze prize at the 9th Inside Edge Paper Awards hosted by Samsung Electro-Mechanics. A Hyundai Heavy Industries official who examined her paper closely at the time encouraged her to apply for a position.

"I thought about it a lot. I had to choose between continuing my studies and taking a job. After several days of deliberation, I chose employment, where I could apply my research results directly in the field. As I put the final period on my application, my heart swelled at the thought of taking a new path."

Son submitted applications not only to Hyundai Heavy Industries but also to other well-known large companies. She was accepted by all of them, and after much consideration, she chose Hyundai Heavy Industries.

"Location was the biggest reason. Even for a company in a larger city, if the conditions were similar to Ulsan, I thought Ulsan would be better. The fact that my alma mater is nearby also played a big role in my choice."

The Hyundai Heavy Industries official who encouraged Son to apply now serves as head of the Process IT Research Lab where she works. Six UNIST graduates in total work at Hyundai Heavy Industries, and four of them work in the Process IT Research Lab with Son. Of the lab's 12 members, 33% are UNIST alumni.

Last October, Son generously donated 1 million won to the UNIST development fund, the largest amount ever given by a student. She was able to make the donation thanks to the paper competition mentioned earlier.

"I was thinking about how best to use the prize money from the paper competition, and it seemed like a good idea to donate it to the school's development fund. I discussed it with Prof. Minseok Song and with my seniors and juniors in the lab before deciding."

Son said she felt indebted to the school. She said the many benefits she enjoyed as a member of the first entering class were not rights she was naturally entitled to, but opportunities given to her by the nation and the local community. She was filled with the thought that she should give them back.

"In truth, donating to the development fund was largely about returning the support I received. Going forward, I want to contribute in my own small way to the stable studies and research of the students who come after me. If possible, I would also like to be active in UNIST alumni activities."

Son also had a word for the juniors at UNIST who are nurturing their dreams of becoming tomorrow's scientists. Her younger brother, Jaeyoung Son (23, School of Mechanical and Advanced Materials Engineering), is also enrolled at UNIST. Perhaps for that reason, Son emphasized that she thinks of the younger students as her own siblings and finds them dear.

"I hope our juniors get to see more of the world. I hope they keep in mind that Banyeon-ri is not the whole world, and that they travel, interact with students from other schools, and broaden their horizons. When you start seeing what you could not see before, you find there is much more to do."
Source: [Interview with Sukyoung Son, UNIST Class of 2009] "I Will Repay the Undeserved Support I Received as a Member of the First Entering Class," November 24, 2014.

title_en: Four Journal Articles Published in 2026
paras_en: The lab's work appeared in Data & Knowledge Engineering, IEEE Access and IEEE Transactions on Semiconductor Manufacturing during 2026.

Data & Knowledge Engineering published an optimized backbone-based process layout generation method that combines integer programming with heuristics to make discovered process models easier to read. IEEE Access published two papers: the automatic generation of traffic simulation models from open data, and MedProSim, a process mining-based simulation tool for identifying the causes of waiting times in outpatient departments. IEEE Transactions on Semiconductor Manufacturing published a framework for identifying and visualising the process attributes that drive yield.
